scope: Step4 V2 ten reference timing, boundary and provenance reconciliation
history: step4/, run_step4.py and all V1 results/evidence remain read-only
cycle_operation: at ceil(physical completion / P), launch existing source into complete combinational operation and capture after nP; destination setup belongs to the path; no duplicate entry setup
capture_only: capture at ceil((original physical completion + receiver setup)/P); no added cycle; no preceding artificial alignment wrapper
native_included_capture: retained complete cycle owns its capture; no added setup/capture; public port admission may still align with zero extra capture margin
transparent_wrapper: ordered repeat/steps containers do not consume time or align; equivalent physical grouping and equivalent cycle-phase splitting preserve timing
PCM_GC_hold: SAR, input/group/bit and old accumulator stable E0 through E2; PCM threshold metadata or GC combinational-popcount inputs likewise stable; no capture/data/control-selection update at E1
PCM_GC_late_control: only existing phase changes at E1; phase/decode/fanout/output-enable path requires a complete E1-to-E2 single cycle
binary_MAC: input/group source pins settle during native read and remain stable across eight bits; ibit and accumulator feedback launch each cycle; first weight capture also receives a complete cycle; no new cache/register/pipeline
preselection_qualification: explicit source-pin delay must fit sourced native lead; do not subtract analog duration from the whole MAC path or use analog time as digital clock limit
clock: max of qualified delay/(capture-launch); target5ns then upward0.5ns grid; rho/tau recomputed together
NAND_budget_controls: only 1x/2x/4x retained affine and 448 calibration arithmetic cycles at fixed native parameters/resources/period; 2 publish cycles unchanged; no full arithmetic certification
GC: raw and effective separate; clock-aligned refresh frame floor(native retention/P)*P; actual repeated writeback endpoints verified within unchanged retention; recompute busy/guard/availability with actual frame; payload zero
preserved_qualifications: NAND unclosed multiplier/round/divider and calibration state
FeRAM PL load and restore delivery
public gate timing is structural engineering envelope, not STA/silicon certification
